messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH — service `api.redwood/v1/generate` experiencing elevated p99 latency and increased error rate. Alert routed to @Ali K., @Samir T. Full runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/api-latency

Ali K.: Ack, I'm looking. Initial graphs show sudden tail in p99 starting 16:01 UTC, CPU on gpu-pool-3 spiking. Rolling few requests into fallback model (redwood-small) for non-enterprise routes to buy time.

infra-bot: scaling action triggered: +2 GPUs to gpu-pool-3 (requested by Ali K.). Scaling status: STARTED.

Ali K.: Update — scaling to +2 timed out on step attach-volume, logs show `timeout waiting for attach`. Trying manual spawn on pool-4.

Maria G.: Noted. Can we enable per-tenant throttles for affected routes? If we drop batching temporarily we can reduce KV cache pressure. Suggest: set `batch.max_tokens=1024` -> `512` and `batch.max_batch_size=8` -> `4`.

Samir T.: Confirming customer impact: monitoring shows ~7% failed requests, latency spikes to 6s p99 for affected endpoints. Affected customers: corp-acct-12 (SLA), partner-x. Joe, can you start customer comms?

Joe C.: On it. I pinged account leads for corp-acct-12, will draft a brief: what happened, mitigations, ETA for fix. ETA for update: 16:30 UTC.

Ali K.: Manual fallback routing applied: traffic for non-SLA routes -> redwood-small; SLA routes still on primary but rate-limited. Observed immediate p99 improvement for non-SLA. Continuing to investigate OOM stack traces.

infra-bot: scaling action FAILED on pool-3: `attach-volume` timeout. Spawning on pool-4 succeeded: instance gpu-4b created.

Ali K.: Handoff: I need to step away for 15m to handle a related infra alarm. Maria, please take on-call for mitigation while I'm away. Context: try rolling kernel to 510.x for worker images, validate KV cache eviction policy, and follow fallback routing if things degrade.

Maria G.: Taking handoff. Setting status in channel: `Mitigation owner: Maria G.` I'll attempt kernel roll and monitor memory utilization.

Samir T.: Thanks. Quick note on rollback plan: if p99 stays >3s after 10m, we must activate the regional fallback route (route-by-cost) to eu-west as backup for affected customers. That will be our customer-impact cutoff.

Ali K.: :thumbsup: Maria, logs I captured live are pasted below for context:
```
E 16:03:12 worker-12 model-infer OOM at kv_cache_refresh()
W 16:03:13 worker-12 evicting 512MB from kv_cache
E 16:03:15 worker-7 attach-volume timeout
```

Maria G.: Kernel roll to 510.73 applied on worker-12, now restarting runtime. Observing memory reclaim and fewer OOMs in the last 3m. p99 trending down to 2.8s. Keeping fallback routing for safety.

Samir T.: Customer comms update?

Joe C.: Sent initial note to affected leads; asked for confirmation if they saw errors. Will follow up after we confirm p99 <2s.

Lisa P.: I'm tracking post-incident items. Can we capture action items now while hot? I'll create a short list and we can size them.

Ella (PM): Please include business priority for each item so we can map to Q2 roadmap. We should tag anything blocking SLA as P0.

Maria G.: Current live mitigations stable. I'll keep the channel open for 30m post-stable then spin up postmortem doc.

Ali K.: Back and verified kernel roll reduced OOMs. Thank you everyone. Suggest we schedule postmortem tomorrow to capture timeline and assign remediation. Proposed time: 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC.

Lisa P.: Draft action items (posting quickly):
1) Investigate attach-volume timeouts and improve attach robustness. Owner: infra team (Joe infra lead). Size: L. Priority: P0 (SLA risk).
2) KV cache tuning for large-sequence requests — avoid evicting hot prefixes. Owner: runtime team (Ali). Size: M. Priority: P1.
3) Add regional fallback automation when p99 > 3s for >5m. Owner: platform (Maria). Size: M. Priority: P0 (operational availability).
4) Improve alerting to include customer-facing SLA hit estimates (automated). Owner: observability (Lisa). Size: S. Priority: P1.
5) Runbook update: include attach-volume mitigation steps and explicit handoff checklist. Owner: oncall docs (Samir). Size: S. Priority: P2.

Samir T.: I'll convert these into tickets: INF-5623 (attach-volume), INF-5624 (kv-cache), INF-5625 (fallback automation), INF-5626 (alerting), INF-5627 (runbook). Adding AC and acceptance criteria.

Ella (PM): For planning, tie P0 items to Q2 capacity sprint. INF-5623 and INF-5625 need headcount in Q2 batch. I'll flag in roadmap and coordinate prioritization with Eng leads.

Joe C.: For customer comms, I'll follow up with a brief postmortem summary once the doc is ready. Also tracking potential credits for corp-acct-12 — will wait for severity confirmation.

Maria G.: Channel status: mitigations stable, handback to Ali at 16:58 UTC. I'll remain on-call overlap for postmortem notes.

Ali K.: Thanks all. Next steps: Maria to capture timeline + logs, Lisa to create tickets and size, Samir to update runbook, Ella to map P0s into Q2 roadmap. Postmortem doc and invite -> I'll post link in channel when created. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: scaling cleanup completed, gpu-4b decommissioned as part of cost-sweep.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC. Attendees: infra, runtime, observability, product.

Lisa P.: I'll open the postmortem doc now and link tickets. Thanks everyone for fast response.

Joe C.: Noted, will prepare customer-facing language for the postmortem.

Maria G.: Closing channel for active mitigation; keeping thread for postmortem coordination.
